title: Beet Borscht with Ukrainian Dumplings
description: A hearty and comforting beet-based soup with Ukrainian-style dumplings, perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Heat the mushroom broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the peeled and diced beets and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped fermented cabbage and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the Ukrainian dumplings and cook for 5 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
